ng-add.description: Install @infra-tools/agentic-ui peer deps and wire provideAgenticUi + provideAgUiBackend in app.config.ts.

tool.description: Scaffold a client tool: *.tool.ts with agenticTool({...}) and a Zod argument schema.

widget.description: Scaffold a generative-UI widget: standalone Angular component + *.widget.ts factory with a Zod props schema.

chat-shell.description: Scaffold a route + standalone component embedding <mvk-chat-shell>.

backend.description: Scaffold a custom AgenticBackend adapter and its provideXxxBackend(...) factory.

agent-server.description: Scaffold a Hono-based AG-UI agent server with an EchoAgent (or other ServerAgent) template.

mfe-capability.description: Scaffold a CapabilityModule for an MFE remote: capability.ts + capabilities.json manifest.

action.description: Scaffold an agentic action (NgRx-style command) — *.action.ts with agenticAction({...}).

intent.description: Scaffold an intent → tool/action/route mapping with examples and Zod schema.

form.description: Scaffold a schema-driven form: *.form.ts with agenticForm({...}) and Zod fieldsSchema.

trigger.description: Scaffold a TriggerDef (ADR-045) — cron / webhook / queue with a tool / action / notification target.

dashboard.description: Scaffold a DashboardDef (ADR-044) with tile placeholders for tool / data / static invocations.

playbook.description: Scaffold a PlaybookDef (post-chat-surfaces P5) — a versioned tool-call sequence with approval + continueOnError step hints.
